title: Share one email check between signup and newsletter
instruction: signup.js and newsletter.js each validate email addresses their own way and disagree. Create email.js exporting isEmail(value) and use it in both. A valid address has no spaces, exactly one @, something before it, and a domain with at least one dot and no empty parts (so a@b and a@b. are invalid). Surrounding whitespace is ignored. The newsletter should store the trimmed, lowercased address.
